title: A lane learns before CI that a landed folder takes no subfolder
why: A lane's nested file no longer fails the install test in CI, after review is done.
note: Coordinator 01:47 CST Nov 7: twice now (batch 38 testdata; batch 49 #1332 docs/design/3d-browser-dummy/) a lane's nested files failed hooks/test_install_src.sh case 8, because the install's land_dir copies only flat files. Decide: the landed folders copy subfolders, or a lint refuses a nested file in a landed folder at commit time, so lanes learn it before CI. No owner question.
